**Sinar Sinar Pelancongan Sdn. Bhd. – Quick Vetting Snapshot** | **Aspect** | **Key Points** | |------------|----------------| | **Company basics** | • Private limited (Sdn. Bhd.)
• Registration No.: **SYN‑001212**
• Incorporated 17 Jan 1998
• Headquartered in **Kuala Lumpur**
• Industry: **Hospitality** – operates a boutique hotel in Kuching
• **Current status:** *Winding up* | | **Ownership & control** | • 3 individual shareholders (the three directors) – 56.47 % (Director 3), 33.42 % (Director 2), 10.11 % (Director 1)
• Directors: Managing Director (appointed 2014), Executive Director (appointed 14 Oct 2024), Director (appointed 2001) | | **Financial health (FY 2022‑2024)** | • **Revenue trend:** ↓ from RM 6.97 M (2022) → RM 5.77 M (2023) → RM 4.51 M (2024) (≈ 35 % drop in 2 years)
• **Profitability:** Gross margin fell from 65 % → 56 %; Net profit margin shrank from 5.8 % → 0.9 % (2024)
• **Liquidity:** Quick ratio stays healthy (≈ 2.0‑2.8) and cash‑to‑revenue ≈ 12‑17 %
• **Cash flow:** Operating cash flow positive but falling; free cash flow negative in 2023‑2024
• **Leverage:** Debt‑to‑equity falling (0.36 → 0.16); interest coverage slipping to **1.9×** (2024) – borderline for debt service | | **Audit** | All three years audited by **Audit Firm 8** with **unqualified opinions** – no red‑flagged accounting issues. | | **Legal exposure** | • 8 court cases (201‑2025).
• Ongoing **employment claims** (RM 404 k pending, RM 74.9 k pending).
• **Tenancy dispute** – judgment entered (RM 243 k).
• **Construction disputes** – one settled, one withdrawn.
• **Winding‑up petitions** – two judgments entered (including a RM 9.47 m claim in 2021).
• Overall litigation exposure ≈ **RM 10 M** (mostly settled or pending). | | **Red flags for suppliers/partners** | 1. **Winding‑up status** – indicates the company is in the process of liquidation.
2. **Steady revenue and profit decline** plus deteriorating cash generation.
3. **Interest coverage < 2×** (2024) – limited ability to meet debt obligations.
4. **Multiple pending lawsuits** (employment, tenancy) and historic winding‑up petitions. | | **Potential positives** | • Strong short‑term liquidity (quick ratio > 2).
• Fully audited financials with clean opinions.
• Concentrated ownership may simplify decision‑making. | | **Bottom line for vetting** | The combination of **winding‑up status**, **declining financial performance**, **tight debt service coverage**, and **significant unresolved litigation** makes Sinar Sinar Pelancongan a **high‑risk candidate** for new supplier contracts or partnership projects. Proceed only if the engagement is low‑value, short‑term, and backed by strong contractual protections (e.g., escrow, performance bonds). |
